title: Battery Disconnect Switch – Master Power Switch 12/24V
descriptionHtml:
Protect the battery when the vehicle sits idle

If the car, boat or motorhome sits unused for a long time, the battery easily drains. That's both annoying and can damage the battery.

Cut the power with a twist

With this disconnect switch you cut the power completely with a simple turn of the knob. It prevents discharge and also works as theft protection. It fits 12V and 24V.

Features

  • Cuts the power completely with one knob
  • Prevents discharge during long periods of storage
  • Works as simple theft protection
  • Fits 12V and 24V
  • Good for cars, boats, motorhomes and trucks

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
